title: Lead Product Manager
description:
**Who are we?**
===============

At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries.

**Job Title**

Lead Product Manager (Technical SME)

  

**Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Lead Product Manager (Technical SME) who will act as a technology think tank for strategic initiatives across the payments domain applications GlobalPayPlus and Payments To Go. The role requires deep expertise in microservices architecture, infrastructure & 3rd party components and multi-cloud platforms and services.

The candidate will drive end-to-end technical initiatives from initiation through deployment and adoption. The candidate will participate in implementing the technical strategy, solution definition, planning, coordination, tracking, governance, and delivery execution.

The role combines technical leadership, program management, and product thinking to ensure successful business outcomes.

The candidate will work closely with product owners, engineering teams, architects, customers, and adopters to shape technical direction, integration strategy and implementation planning.

This role will report into the org of Director-Technical Product Management.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define technical strategy and architecture in alignment with the Technology roadmap for payments platforms and modernization initiatives.
* Own strategic technical initiatives from concept through deployment, adoption, and business outcomes.
* Lead technical solution design, migration and transformation initiatives across payments platforms and infrastructure.
* Lead technical assessments, facilitate architecture decisions, technology evaluations, AI solution integration and migration strategies.
* Review solutions & designs and emphasize on the performance , scalability, resiliency, security, and operational testing and readiness as a product stakeholder .
* Drive planning, execution, governance, and stakeholder alignment across product, engineering, architecture, operations, and customer teams.
* Work with the Program Management teams and define milestones, dependencies, risks, and delivery progress.
* Partner with customers and adopters to define requirements, rollout plans, and adoption strategies.
Align business objectives, technical direction, and delivery outcomes. Provide strategic guidance to senior stakeholders.  

  

**Product & Program Leadership Experience**

* 15+ years of experience leading large cross-functional programs from initiation, delivery, implementation and business value feedback for product.
* Proven track record of product management accomplishments and initiatives with demonstrated success in planning and end-to-end execution of initiatives.
* Experience managing dependencies, stakeholders, and executive communications.
* Ability to balance business priorities, technical decisions, and customer adoption goals.

Experience working with global teams, executive leadership, and customer engagements.  

  

**Functional Skills**

* Strong Payments and Banking domain experience.
Knowledge of payment processing platforms.  

  

**Technical Skills**

* Enterprise platform modernization, cloud-native platforms, and microservices architecture.
* Ability to evaluate technology options and define long-term architecture roadmaps.
* Java, Spring Boot. Kubernetes, Docker, OpenShift, Kafka, MQ , Elastic Search, Grafana, Prometheus, Loki. PostgreSQL, Oracle.
* Integrations over Rest, MQ, Kafka.
* REST APIs and API Gateways.
* OAuth, OIDC, Central Key Management
* CI/CD and DevOps toolchains.
Logging, monitoring, and observability platforms.  

  

**Experience**

15+ Years

  

**Location**

Pune

  

We are proud to offer a range of incentives to our employees worldwide. These benefits are available to everyone, regardless of grade, and reflect the values we stand for:

**Flexibility:** Enjoy unlimited vacation, subject to local regulations and business priorities. Benefit from hybrid working arrangements and inclusive policies such as paid time off for voting, bereavement, and sick leave.

**Well‑being:** Access confidential one‑to‑one support through our Employee Assistance Program, connect with our network of Wellbeing Champions and Gather Groups, and take part in monthly events and initiatives designed to help you thrive—inside and outside of work.

**Health & Financial Security:** Medical, life and disability insurance, retirement plans, lifestyle, and other benefits.\*

**Sustainability:** Paid time off for volunteering and donation‑matching opportunities to support causes that matter to you.

**Inclusion:** Get involved in our inclusion communities, such as Count Me In, Culture@Finastra, Proud@Finastra, Disabilities@Finastra, and Women@Finastra—open to everyone who wants to participate and contribute.

**Career Development:** Access online learning and accredited courses through our Skills & Career Navigator tool.

**Recognition:** Take part in our global recognition program, Finastra Celebrates, and share your voice through regular employee surveys that help shape our culture and ways of working.

* Specific benefits may vary by location.

At Finastra, each individual is unique—bringing their own ideas, perspectives, cultural backgrounds, and experiences. We learn from one another, value what makes us different, and create an environment where everyone feels included, supported, and able to be their authentic selves.

Be unique. Be exceptional. Help us make a difference at Finastra.

title: Product Manager (Digital Products, Payments) - Pune – 7+ years Exp
description:
**Ready to take your career global?**

Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a Lead Product Manager to join our ever-evolving Marketplace and VAS Experience Team and help us unleash the potential of every business.

**What you’ll own**

  

* Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for one of the payments portal, from strategy and discovery through delivery, adoption, and continuous optimization.
* Define and maintain the product roadmap, aligning customer needs, business objectives, operational efficiency goals, and regulatory requirements.
* Drive the evolution of merchant and payee self-service capabilities, including payout tracking, account management, reporting, reconciliation, and issue resolution.
* Collaborate with engineering, design, risk, compliance, operations, customer support, and commercial teams to deliver scalable, secure, and compliant payout experiences.
* Manage the product backlog, define business requirements, write and review user stories, and prioritize features based on customer value, business impact, and technical feasibility.
* Leverage customer insights, usage analytics, support trends, and market intelligence to identify opportunities for innovation and experience improvements.
* Own key portal capabilities such as payout visibility, payment status tracking, notifications, dispute management, reporting, and reconciliation workflows.
* Drive portal adoption and engagement by simplifying user journeys and increasing self-service rates for merchants and operational teams.
* Partner with internal platforms, payments, and other cross functional teams to deliver seamless integrations that support domestic and cross-border payout experiences.
* Define and monitor product success metrics, including portal adoption, self-service utilization, customer satisfaction, operational efficiency, and payout transparency.
* Act as the subject matter expert for the experience, providing guidance to internal stakeholders and influencing the long-term product vision.
* Balance customer needs, business priorities, compliance requirements, and technical constraints to deliver measurable outcomes and strategic value.

**What you bring**

**Required Qualifications:**

  

* MBA/ Master’s degree from Tier-1 Institutions.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related fields
* 7 + years of experience in digital product management
* Experience working in a multinational organization, preferably within fintech, payments, banking or management consultancy
* Proven experience working with payment gateways, POS systems, e-commerce platforms, or acquiring banks.
* Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools like JIRA, Confluence, and product analytics platforms.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Strong understanding of payout ecosystems, including ACH, Faster Payments, RTP, SEPA, domestic and cross-border payment rails.
* Knowledge of payment orchestration, banking integrations, APIs, and event-driven platform architectures.
* Understanding of treasury, liquidity management, and funding models related to merchant payouts.
* Experience leading large cross-functional initiatives across Product, Engineering, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and Commercial teams.

**About the team**

Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections – it’s unmatched. Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.

**What makes a Globalpayer?**

Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.

Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.

title: Senior Officer, Branch Relationship Manager, Consumer Banking Group
description:
**Business Function**

As the leading bank in Asia, DBS Consumer Banking Group is in a unique position to help our customers realise their dreams and ambitions across ~500 branches in the country. As a market leader in the consumer banking business, DBS has a full spectrum of products and services, including deposits (incl. structured solutions for NRI), investments, insurance, mortgages, credit cards and personal loans to help our customers realise their dreams and aspirations at every life stage.

**Responsibilities**

* To deliver exceptional volume and revenue performance by acquiring and engaging with DBS clients having an AUM => INR 1 million through “need-based approach” and ensure client coverage and product penetration through cross-sell and up-sell of DBS products and services.
* To manage & maintain the highest customer satisfaction and service levels through pro-active client engagement & relationship management, coordinating internally with DBS Service and Distribution and Product team
* Acquire and upgrade quality clients in the branch location areas to Treasures segment.
* Engage with existing customers to deepen the wallet share through retention and growth of AUM.
* Accountable for achieving monthly & annual volume and revenue objective, as agreed.
* Ensure activation of e-Channels (I-Banking / M-Banking/ Online MF/Debit Card) and Savings Book growth
* Ensure proper implementation & execution of product strategies through effective relationship management.
* Develop the client trust and loyalty for entrenched relationship with DBS through lifestyle and beyond banking propositions
* Ensure optimum product mix and new- to- product clients aimed at customer level profitability and enhancing client coverage.
* Drive and deliver exemplary customer service in the local market and uphold DBS service standards.
* Ensure internal and regulatory compliance through strict adherence to DBS sales process, timely risk reviews and exercising due diligence while on-boarding.
* Ensure exemplary service delivery of these clients by building appropriate workflows and processes incl. doorstep banking etc.
* Establish, manage and grow the AUM of mapped Client segment by acquiring and nurturing the client having AUM => INR 1 M
* Ensure complete knowledge of all products & services through continuous skill and knowledge improvement.
* Resolve customer queries and complaints within the agreed TAT as per the DBS customer service policy.
* Coordinate and work closely with CBG colleagues, Service teams, Product specialist to ensure that team objectives are met through an environment that nurtures harmony and collaboration through teamwork
* Work closely with the Line Manager and City / Cluster Head to ensure achievement of common team and Branch objectives.
* Ensure internal and regulatory compliance and address operational risks if any, e.g. Health & Safety standards, security of premises, AML / KYC and ongoing risk reviews.
* To exercise appropriate due diligence while on-boarding and engaging with clients.
* Establish DBS as a primary banker for clients and as a prominent banking provider in India.

**Requirements**

* Minimum 2 years of experience in a reputed bank and proficient in banking products.
* In-depth knowledge of local market and competition.
* AMFI / IRDAI / FEDAI certified candidates with BCSBI certification would be an added advantage.
* Graduate (10+2+3).

We offer a competitive salary and benefits package and the professional advantages of a dynamic environment that supports your development and recognises your achievements.

Vena is on a journey to transform the way organizations plan to grow their businesses, and we’re looking for a detail\-oriented and technically savvy Product Owner to support our Data Integrations  

portfolio. This role is based in Indore, India, where you will work closely with a fully India\-based development team to deliver integration and extensibility capabilities that are foundational to Vena’s platform strategy.  

In this role, you’ll help unlock the ability for customers and Vena’s partner ecosystem to enhance the value of the Vena platform as a single source of truth for all their financial and operational data. You’ll play a key part in enabling seamless data connectivity and  

extensibility, powering customers’ corporate data strategies with downstream solutions like business intelligence dashboards, AI/ML\-driven forecasting, and more.  

If you're excited by the challenge of building high\-impact, technically sophisticated capabilities that shape the future of enterprise planning and performance, we want to hear from you.### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Collaborate with Product Managers, designers, and software engineers to define product requirements and deliver new features for Vena’s data integrations and extensibility platform.

* Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Engineering, Support, Customer Success, Sales, and Professional Services to drive execution and adoption.
* Other duties as assigned

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

  

* 2\+ years of experience as a Product Owner at a B2B SaaS company and 3–5 years in software development or delivery.
* Experience building or supporting data integration and ETLpipelines using iPaaS platforms, APIs, or ETL tools.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, data pipelines, and integration patterns across SaaS ecosystems.
* Technically hands\-on with an ability to understand the architecture and constraints of integration platforms and services.
* Excellent communicator (written and verbal) with a collaborative working style.
* Skilled in Agile development processes, backlog management, and crossfunctional collaboration.
* Data\-driven mindset and experience using quantitative methods to guide decisions.
* Interest in AI and willingness to explore AI\-driven solutions to enhance performance and drive efficiencies

**S*****alary range 14,00,000 \- 21,30,000 INR***  

  

* *Our salaries are tailored to roles, levels and locations. Your individual pay within this range is influenced by factors like work location, skills, experience and education. As you progress in your role, your compensation may adapt, offering flexibility for growth beyond initial levels. For specifics, your recruiter will provide details and address any questions during the hiring process.*
  

### **About Vena Solutions**


At Vena, we’re reimagining how businesses plan and grow: powered by data, collaboration, and innovation  

  

Headquartered in Toronto with a global reach, we help finance teams work smarter using the tools they already love (yes, we’re talking about Excel!). Trusted by over 1,800 organizations and 150,000\+ users every day, Vena Solutions brings clarity to complexity.  

  

We're a people led company that leads with our CORE values (Customer Trust, One Team, Respect \& Authenticity and Execution Excellence) and are driven by our mission

Build your future with our Employee Stock Option Program, Retirement Savings, Support \& 401k Matching Programs.

title: Product Owner – B
description:
**vConstruct** is a construction technology company based in Pune, India. vConstruct specializes in providing services and solutions in Virtual Design and Construction (VDC), Project Controls Management, Accounting, Data Science and Analytics and Software Development.


vConstruct, an entrepreneurial organization, has forayed into product development for construction by leveraging its deep understanding of construction processes and driven by our deeply rooted core value of Ever forward Spirit.


vConstruct is looking for people who are passionate about transforming the construction industry by using technology.


vConstruct made a commitment to this journey of product development by starting “vC Labs” in 2022\. vC Labs is a dedicated team of people who come from the construction domain and technology domain to build solutions for problems we see in the construction management workflows by leveraging 3D web and mobile development, data science and analytics, AI/ML etc.


In less than a year of existence, the team has grown to 20 and has built 6 solutions that solve real world problems in construction management workflows for various vConstruct teams. These solutions also hold potential for similar users in the construction industry beyond vConstruct. The team has also come up with the initial prototype of the industry leading product based on the theme of BIM enabled integrated workflows.


With a vision to transform the construction industry by the use of technology, we truly believe that we will bring upon the transition not just by services but by market facing products as well.


We are seeking a driven and domain\-minded **Product Owner** to take ownership of key modules within our B2B SaaS construction technology platform.


In this role, you will act as the bridge between business stakeholders, field/industry experts, design, and engineering. You will be responsible for translating product strategy and customer needs into well\-defined user stories, prioritizing the product backlog, and driving delivery through agile development cycles.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Backlog Management \& Agile Execution**

* **Maintain \& Prioritize Backlog:** Define, groom, and prioritize product backlogs based on business value, customer feedback, and strategic vision.
* **Story Writing \& Acceptance Criteria:** Write detailed user stories, technical requirements, epic descriptions, and clear acceptance criteria (Definition of Done).
* **Sprint Planning \& Ceremonies:** Partner closely with engineering teams in daily standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, and sprint retrospectives.
* **Feature Delivery:** Serve as the primary decision\-maker during sprint development to clarify requirements and keep engineering teams moving efficiently.

**Domain \& Customer Focus**

* **Deep Domain Understanding:** Develop a granular understanding of construction workflows (e.g., job costing, RFIs/Submittals, field reporting, equipment tracking, BIM integration, or compliance).
* **Voice of the Customer:** Gather continuous feedback from field operators, project managers, and enterprise buyers to refine features and drive product\-market fit.
* **On\-site / Field Insights:** Periodically engage with users through interviews, site visits, and usability testing to validate features.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* **Strategic Alignment:** Work closely with Product Managers to translate the broader roadmap into execution\-ready sprints.
* **Go\-To\-Market Support:** Collaborate with Customer Success, Sales, and Product Marketing to ensure smooth feature launches, documentation, and user onboarding.
* **Data\-Driven Decisions:** Monitor feature adoption, usage metrics, and customer feedback post\-launch to continuously iterate on functionality.

**What We’re Looking For**

* **Experience:** 3\+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or Associate Product Manager in a software environment.
* **Domain Exposure:** Background in Construction Tech, PropTech, Real Estate Tech, or related field/industrial software (ERP, Field Management, CAD/BIM, Asset Management) is strongly preferred.
* **B2B SaaS Experience:** Proven track record in B2B SaaS products, understanding multi\-tenant architectures, user permissions, and enterprise workflow complexities.
* **Agile Proficiency:** Deep understanding of Agile/Scrum frameworks and experience using management tools like Jira, Azure DevOps, or Linear.
* **Communication Skills:** Exceptional ability to synthesize complex field processes into structured, developer\-friendly requirements.
* **Technical Aptitude:** Comfortable discussing technical trade\-offs, APIs, data integrations, and system architecture with engineers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with industry integrations (e.g., Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, Sage, QuickBooks, Primavera P6\).
* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or equivalent product management certification.
* Direct background working in construction management, civil engineering, or project control.

  

About vConstruct: vConstruct specializes in providing high quality Building Information Modeling, Lean Construction, Integrated Project Delivery and Software Solutions for global construction projects. vConstruct is a wholly owned subsidiary of DPR Construction, USA. The Software Unit for vConstruct works on many interesting problems in Construction Technology. It works across different sets of software technologies such as Web Applications, Workflow Management, Analytics, Machine Learning and IoT. For more information, please visit www.vconstruct.com.


DPR Construction is a commercial general contractor and construction manager in USA specializing in technically challenging and sustainable projects for advanced technology, biopharmaceutical, corporate office, and higher education and healthcare markets. With the purpose of building great things—great teams, great buildings, great relationships—DPR is a truly great company. For more information, please visit www.dpr.com.

title: Data Intelligence Manager
description:
**Who we're looking for**



Fieldwire is looking for a Data Intelligence Manager to join our Data \& Operations team based in Pune, India. You will be the operational owner of reporting and analytics for a core business function (G\&A, R\&D, or GTM), turning raw data into accurate, timely, and trusted intelligence that drive decisions at the executive and departmental level. You will work closely with our Data Engineers, DIM Team Lead, and business partners to build dashboards, define KPIs, and maintain rigorous data quality. This role is critical to the integrity and scalability of our reporting landscape.


**What you'll be doing**


**The primary responsibilities for this role include:**


* Own the end\-to\-end delivery of non\-native dashboards for your assigned business function (G\&A, R\&D, or GTM), combining data across multiple source systems into a single, accurate view
* Build, maintain, and continuously improve dashboards and BI products (Power BI or equivalent), ensuring they are always live, accurate, and clearly documented
* Define and govern KPIs and performance metrics for your business area, ensuring consistent definitions across teams and regions
* Act as the primary business partner for stakeholders in your assigned function — translating business questions into analytical requirements and delivering clear, decision\-ready intelligence
* Conduct extensive QA on all data outputs: validate inputs, test transformations, reconcile outputs against source systems, and prevent conflicting or duplicate reporting
* Maintain a single source of truth for your reporting area, ensuring consistency across all dashboards and outputs
* Manage a release and change control process for dashboard updates — including testing, versioning, and stakeholder communication before any changes go live
* Monitor data quality continuously; detect and escalate anomalies, breaks, or integrity issues early
* Document all metrics, logic, and definitions clearly so that any stakeholder can understand what the data means and how it is calculated
* Contribute to cross\-training within the DIM team to ensure coverage and reduce single points of failure
* Support the DIM Team Lead and Director of Operations in roadmap planning and continuous improvement of the reporting landscape


**At Fieldwire, we're looking for our next Data Intelligence Manager to have the following skills and experiences:**


* 3\-5 years of experience in a data analytics, business intelligence, or data intelligence role
* Strong proficiency in SQL and hands\-on experience building dashboards in Power BI
* Experience working with large datasets across multiple systems and understanding how to combine them into coherent reporting
* Demonstrated ability to conduct rigorous QA on data outputs and maintain high standards of accuracy
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills — able to identify inconsistencies and root\-cause data issues independently
* Experience defining and governing KPIs and metrics frameworks
* Excellent communication skills — able to present complex data findings clearly to non\-technical business stakeholders
* Familiarity with ETL/ELT concepts and how data pipelines work upstream of analytics
* Detail\-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
* Comfortable working across time zones in a globally distributed team


**And if you have any of the following, we** **REALLY** **want you to apply today!**


* Experience in a SaaS or technology company, ideally with exposure to GTM, Finance, or R\&D data
* Familiarity with Salesforce reporting and data structures
* Experience working with dbt, Snowflake, or similar modern data stack components
* Exposure to data governance frameworks and metric catalogues
* Prior experience supporting executive\-level reporting or board\-level dashboards
* Background in construction technology or field operations analytics is a plus


**Why Fieldwire?**



The field\-first construction platform for less busywork and more building. Trusted on 4M\+ projects worldwide, Fieldwire by Hilti gives crews reliable access to plans, tasks, and updates on one simple platform. It unites the field and office around a single, transparent source of truth, keeping teams aligned from start to finish. Designed for easy adoption, crews gain real\-time visibility into progress, clear ownership of work, and the context to make confident decisions. As part of the Hilti Group, Fieldwire combines deep construction expertise with modern digital innovation to deliver better outcomes on every job. Learn more at Fieldwire.com.


**Where is the job located?**



This role is hybrid in Pune, India.


*Monday \& Friday: WFH* *2:00 PM–10:00 PM IST to align with our global team's operating hours.*


*Tuesday\-Thursday \- 1**2:00 PM–8:00 PM IST to align with our global team's operating hours.*

title: Lead Product Manager - Technical
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Lead Product Manager \- Technical
Who is Mastercard?
  

  

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  

  

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  

  

Overview
  

  

The Mastercard Dispute Lifecycle team in Pune have an exciting opportunity for a Lead Product Management \- Technical to help further enhance and modernize our Dispute management platform.  

  

The ideal candidate will quickly develop a deep technical understanding of the applications and systems they support, demonstrating a willingness to dive in, challenge assumptions, and ask thoughtful, probing questions to ensure plans are executed effectively and efficiently.  

  

They will bring a strong interest in Payments domain, along with proven technical leadership, and the ability to think creatively applying innovative, out\-of\-the\-box approaches to solve complex problems  

  

Role
  

  

* Customer obsession: Champion a deep understanding of customer needs, the broader ecosystem, and key market dynamics, and embed these insights into product decisions
* Systems analysis \& design: Develop an in\-depth understanding of the product platform and its surrounding ecosystem; produce high\-quality functional artifacts for Engineering, including data flows, sequence diagrams, APIs, and interface specifications
* Backlog management: Define and maintain a clear roadmap aligned to business objectives; translate system designs into well\-structured features and user stories that are ready for Engineering execution
* Story elaboration: Lead refinement sessions and create detailed, comprehensive acceptance criteria to ensure clarity and delivery readiness
* Technical analysis: Provide rigorous analysis of application software to validate that business and functional requirements can be effectively delivered
* Strategic alignment: Partner with stakeholders to ensure backlogs are prioritized and refined based on business value, impact, and measurable outcomes
* Agile mindset: Advocate for and model agile best practices across the product lifecycle—from defining epics to writing actionable user stories and acceptance criteria
* Continuous improvement: Measure outcomes, evaluate existing practices and metrics, and drive ongoing optimization across processes, roles, and delivery execution

  

All About You
  

  

* Proven product experience: Several years of product management or new product development experience delivering high\-quality products, with the ability to clearly articulate business context and customer use cases
* Technical product expertise: Experience managing highly technical platforms or API\-driven services, with strong software architecture and systems design knowledge
* ISO8583 knowledge (preferred): Familiarity with key payments and dispute management concepts is a plus
* Lean \& Agile delivery: Hands\-on experience with Lean product management and agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), along with CI/CD and modern DevOps practices
* End\-to\-end ownership: Demonstrated success delivering features from design through development, deployment, and customer integration
* Backlog management: Expertise in grooming epics, features, and user stories; defining clear acceptance and exit criteria; and effectively prioritizing platform backlogs
* Data\-driven decision making: Ability to define and leverage SMART metrics (leading and lagging) to guide product strategy and measure success
* Collaboration \& stakeholder management: Proven ability to work across global, cross\-functional teams, align diverse perspectives, and manage dependencies and co\-development opportunities
* Thrives in ambiguity: Comfortable navigating uncertainty; proactively identifies solutions, engages the right stakeholders, and drives clarity
* Continuous improvement \& communication: Committed to optimizing team processes for speed, quality, and innovation, with excellent written and verbal communication skills

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
